1. **[P1] Invocation retains a stale wall deadline after uptime consumes additional loop allowance.**

   [runAdmission.ts:328](</Users/pmark/.codex/worktrees/0c59/arcadia/src/scout/runAdmission.ts:328>) checks current elapsed time but returns the original `token.deadline` at line 337. [reviewExecutor.ts:285](</Users/pmark/.codex/worktrees/0c59/arcadia/src/execution/reviewExecutor.ts:285>) uses that deadline directly to set GNU timeout.

   Independent synthetic reproduction: reserve the reviewed retry at minute 89; then simulate 30 seconds of suspension and a corresponding backward civil-clock adjustment. Monotonic time advances 100 ms, uptime advances 30,100 ms, and the boot identity stays unchanged. Consumption succeeds:

   ```json
   {"admitted":true,"actualLoopRemainingMs":29900,"executorTimeoutFromReturnedDeadlineMs":59900,"overrunMs":30000,"stopped":null}
   ```

   This permits the live adapter’s timer to exceed the 90-minute total-loop bound by 30 seconds. Linux supports this distinction: monotonic time excludes suspension, while Node’s uptime implementation reads `/proc/uptime` or `CLOCK_BOOTTIME`. [Kernel documentation](https://cdn.kernel.org/doc/html/latest/core-api/timekeeping.html), [Node 22.23.1 source](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nodejs/node/v22.23.1/deps/uv/src/unix/linux.c).

   Recompute the effective invocation duration from the current trusted elapsed sample, or refuse the discrepancy. Preserve the tighter private deadline and expiry.

   Reproduction: [review-suspend-deadline.mts](/private/tmp/arcadia-1457-r2-ht8wx8wc/review-suspend-deadline.mts); [raw result](/private/tmp/arcadia-1457-r2-suspend-deadline.log). Exit **0**, demonstrating the defect; zero provider calls.

2. **[P2] Harmless approval wording turns successful execution into an authority failure.**

   [executionFailure.ts:16](</Users/pmark/.codex/worktrees/0c59/arcadia/src/scout/executionFailure.ts:16>) matches any occurrence of `approval`. The shared executor then converts that classification into an error even on exit zero.

   An independent public-path test wrote the exact valid `HelloWorld.txt`, exited zero, and printed:

   ```text
   Created HelloWorld.txt. No approval required.
   ```

   The Run became **failed**, with an authority diagnostic. Match actual refusal wording rather than the noun alone.

   [Public reproduction test](/private/tmp/arcadia-1457-r2-ht8wx8wc/tests/review-public-diagnostic.test.ts): **1/1 defect-reproduction assertion passed, exit 0**. It used synthetic clock observations and scripted execution.
